signals.source_text: Forest Giants added understanding of how living growth could reinforce stone through root-systems that bound rather than cracked.
The result was a stepped pyramid forty feet tall, each layer set back from the one below, creating terraces where vegetation could grow.
The interior contained chambers—spaces shaped through consciousness-touch to create specific acoustic properties.
Nephoretti who entered with minor injuries found their healing accelerated.

But by year two hundred, a dozen pyramids stood across the island and mainland—monuments to cooperation between species, between factions, between beings learning to build something larger than survival required.
